title: First Glance
hint: Press & hold any arrow to preview its path. Clear the unblocked ones first!

title: Crossroads
hint: One arrow blocks two others. Spot the free exit first.

title: Around the Bend
hint: Bent arrows still only fly in the direction their tip points!

title: Pinwheel
hint: A classic 4-way lock—find which outer arm is free to unwind the spiral.

title: Serpent Knot
hint: Trace the long U-shaped arrow—it can only leave once the top lane clears.

title: Key & Lock
hint: Arrows with a diamond badge are Key Arrows—escape them to open matching Color Gates!

title: Double Door
hint: Unlock the Amber Gate first so the Indigo arrow can free the Cyan Key.

title: Vaulted Spiral
hint: Clear the outer Rose arrow to reach the Amber Key.

title: Cross-Lock
hint: Both gates guard the center. Find the one key arrow that starts unblocked.

title: Chain Reaction
hint: Unwind from the top-right: Rose frees Cyan Key, which opens the bottom lane.

title: First Bounce
hint: Diagonal bumpers ( / and \ ) bend an arrow 90°! Hold to trace the bounce.

title: Bank Shot
hint: Watch out: a bumper can bounce an arrow straight into another arrow!

title: Double Mirror
hint: An arrow can bounce twice in one shot! Trace the Z-shaped escape.

title: Periscope
hint: Clear the top-right blocker first so the bottom arrow can ricochet out.

title: Mirror Maze
hint: Use Hold-to-Trace carefully—one bumper points into the center lane.

title: Thin Ice
hint: Tapping an arrow aimed at Ice shatters the Ice safely (no heart lost!), then tap again to escape.

title: Icebreaker
hint: Break the ice on the left to open a path for two different arrows.

title: Frozen Core
hint: You cannot break ice from behind another arrow—clear the outer shell first.

title: Glacier Grid
hint: Crack the top ice with the vertical arrow, then clear the horizontal stack.

title: Avalanche
hint: Every ice block is guarded—work from the edges inward.

title: Prism Lock
hint: Bounce the Key Arrow off the mirror to escape, then unlock the Amber Gate!

title: Frost Mirror
hint: Shatter the ice *after* the bumper—yes, ricocheting arrows break ice too!

title: Twin Vault
hint: Break the bottom ice first to clear the mirror lane, then unlock both gates in order.

title: Clockwork
hint: Bounce the Amber Key out the top-right, then unwind the center pinwheel.

title: Grand Finale
hint: Use every trick you learned: bounce the Cyan Key up, clear the bottom lane, and unlock the Amber Gate!
